thread:
Marta (Marketing): Quick coordination thread for Wednesday launch. Need confirmations: final CMS copy, embargo schedule, press list accuracy, partner sneak preview, and CTAs. Looping Legal & Product.

Ajay (PR): Press list snapshot attached in the tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/presslist (col H shows embargo status). I can prepare embargoed pitches once Legal signs off.

Noah (Growth): Partners asked for an early read. Proposal: T-10h read-only preview link, then partner Braze send at T-2h with tracking params. That gives partners time to troubleshoot tracking hooks.

Claire (Product): CMS publish slot is 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC. Confirm embargo lift aligns. Also request the final CEO 1-line quote for the blog header.

Sam (Legal): Scanned the PR. Two small edits: drop any absolute performance claims (e.g., "instant") and include the DPA and subprocessor list link. I'll paste exact language into the PR doc.

Ajay (PR): Question: distribute benchmark appendix to embargoed press at T-2h or hold until T=0? Thoughts?

Marta (Marketing): Give embargoed press the appendix at T-2h with a clear embargo note. Partner preview at T-10h should be summary-only (no full benchmark PDFs).

Noah (Growth): Agreed. Public CTA = "Start free". Partner CTA = "Affiliate dashboard". I'll make sure tracking parameters are in place.

Claire (Product): Ops heads-up: we'll flip the GA feature flag at 15:55 UTC to warm caches. Please ensure CMS publish waits until 16:00 UTC. Rollback plan: auto-switch to model v1.2 if error rate exceeds threshold.

Marta (Marketing): @deploy-bot confirm GA flag timing?

deploy-bot: Scheduled change: GA flag flip at 2026-04-15T15:55:00Z. Publish block active until 2026-04-15T16:00:00Z.

Sam (Legal): Added DPA and subprocessor links to the PR doc and tightened the CEO quote. Ajay, please confirm before sending any embargoed assets.

Ajay (PR): Confirmed 10 PR doc now includes legal links and the approved quote. I'll queue embargoed outreach at T-2h and broad outreach at T=0. Press kit uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.example/launch-kit-2

Marta (Marketing): Social assets live in Drive (/social/launch2). I'll schedule organic posts T=0 and paid promos starting T+30m.

Claire (Product): Ops will monitor SLOs for the first 20 minutes. If latency or error rate spikes, we trigger the rollback. Also, avoid content edits in CMS while publish lock is active.

Marta (Marketing): Action items: Ajay - embargo send at T-2h and public send at T=0; Sam - final legal check live in PR doc; Noah - partner preview T-10h and Braze T-2h; Claire/Ops - GA flag at 15:55, rollback ready; Marta - finalize CMS copy and schedule social. Reconvene T-12h for a 5-min check. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
